name: keeper-app-author
description: Build and safely evolve complete Keeper apps from Codex, with validated candidates, reviewed deployment, and live-record protection.

interface.shortDescription: Build and safely evolve Keeper apps
interface.longDescription:
Turn a plain-language operational brief into a complete MechaBee Keeper app from Codex. Keeper App Author can create connected records, lists, tables, boards, dashboards, forms, navigation, workflows, providers, access rules, and in-app agent actions—not just a starter screen. The resulting app runs on desktop and mobile beside your MechaBee files, chats, and agents.

Use it to create a new personal or team app, or to inspect, repair, and evolve an app that is already live. The plugin reads the current Keeper contract, validates the complete candidate, previews a path-by-path diff, and stages the exact change for approval before deployment. Definition-only changes preserve existing live records by default; raw-data changes require explicit intent and the corresponding authority.
capabilities: Build a complete app from a plain-language operational brief
Create connected records, boards, dashboards, forms, and workflows
Add in-app agent actions that work from authorized app data
Inspect, repair, and evolve apps that are already live
Validate and review a path-by-path diff before deployment
Preserve live records during definition-only changes
defaultPrompt: Build a service dispatch app with customers, equipment, technicians, and recurring maintenance.
Turn my project workflow into records, a delivery board, forms, and a weekly summary action.
Add an approval step to my existing app without changing its live records.
